skill_create / skill_evolve?

计划模式工具

返回 allow
默认放行

span.p:
返回 deny
dontAsk 自动拒绝

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
调用端处理 confirm
已确认摘要可复用；否则询问用户

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 调用端拒绝并回写 tool result

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI 初始模式优先级
--yolo → --plan → --accept-edits
→ --dont-ask → default

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI --plan 初始化
生成唯一 plan 路径并注入 prompt
_pre_plan_mode 仍为 None

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
显式进入：/plan 或 enter_plan_mode
_pre_plan_mode = 当前 mode
切换 plan、生成路径并注入 prompt

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Plan Mode active
prompt 声明只读意图
check_permission 部分强制

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
无回调 fallback
permission_mode =
_pre_plan_mode or default

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
退出完成
清除路径与 Plan prompt

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
当前失败点
异步审批回调未 await
随后对 coroutine 调用 .get

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
设计中的审批选择（当前不可达）
继续规划 / 执行 / 清上下文后执行 / 手工执行

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI --plan 未保存 _pre_plan_mode
因此上述赋值退出时落到 default

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. READ_TOOLS 含 compact_context；plan 仅显式拒绝 EDIT_TOOLS 与 run_shell，其他工具可能默认允许
2. exit_plan_mode 把文件路径当作 plan_content，未读取正文
3. 审批分支未把 target_mode 赋给 permission_mode
4. /plan 进入时未同步 OpenAI 已有 system message
